drafts_today.text: Not every great gift is glamorous. For the woman 40+ who looks after everyone else first: a calm-skin trio she'll use every single day this winter. Cleanse, hydrate, seal. DM me and I'll wrap one up. #giftsforher #SkinBarrier
drafts_today.video_tip: 12 seconds: hands tuck three RIMAN products into a gift box one at a time, ribbon goes on, end card reads 'For the one who never treats herself.'

drafts_today.text: Menopause skin tip I wish I'd heard sooner: when everything stings, it's usually the barrier asking for fewer products, not more. Two weeks of gentle cleanse, hydrate on damp skin, rich cream. Then reassess. #MenopauseSkin #SkinBarrier
drafts_today.video_tip: Split screen: a crowded shelf on the left, three products on the right. Point to each of the three and say one word: Cleanse, Hydrate, Seal.

drafts_today.text: Daily SPF is the step most of us skip, and the one that protects all the work the rest of your routine does. Cloudy November mornings count too. One nickel-sized layer, last step, every day. #Sunscreen #MatureSkin
drafts_today.video_tip: 8 seconds: rain on the window, a nickel of SPF on your fingertip, pat it on, smile. On-screen text: 'Grey days still count.'
